To make it work, you need a base case—a simple condition that stops the calls (like the smallest doll that can't be opened)—and a recursive case that moves toward that base case. For example, to compute the factorial of 5, you compute 5 × factorial(4), which then computes 4 × factorial(3), and so on until you hit factorial(1) = 1.
